universities.name: University of Porto Faculty of Medicine
universities.summary: University of Porto Faculty of Medicine (FMUP) offers a Portuguese-taught Integrated Master in Medicine in Porto. The programme lasts 12 semesters and 360 ECTS credits. For 2026/27, FMUP publishes an international-student route with 12 places, a 16,500 EUR full-time annual tuition figure, faculty-specific application phases and interviews, and registration/accreditation information from Portugal's DGES and A3ES.
universities.campusLifestyle: FMUP describes an integrated curriculum with early contact with health units and patients, elective curricular units and opportunities to participate in biomedical research. The 12-semester route is structured around pre-clinical medical sciences followed by clinical application of the scientific foundation. Instruction is Portuguese; applicants need to treat language preparation as an entry and clinical-learning requirement, not as an optional add-on.
universities.cityProfile: The programme is based in Porto. This bundle does not claim a faculty residence, a monthly living-cost figure or a campus meal price because no current Medicine-specific source was verified. These costs must remain outside the published tuition figure until separately sourced.
universities.practicalExposure: FMUP describes early contact with health units and patients, then a clinical cycle that applies the scientific base acquired in the pre-clinical stage. Its course page describes practical training as a core part of the integrated master. The reviewed sources do not guarantee a named hospital placement for each incoming international student, so the programme is presented through its documented curriculum rather than an unverified hospital promise.
universities.hostelOverview: No Medicine-specific accommodation provider, allocation rule or current residence price was verified in the official sources used for this package. Housing is not presented as included in tuition or as a guaranteed faculty service.
universities.dietarySupport: The reviewed FMUP Medicine and international-admissions sources do not publish a Medicine-specific meal plan or food-cost allowance. Food and day-to-day spending are not included in the stated annual tuition.
universities.safetyOverview: The reviewed official course and international-admissions materials do not publish Medicine-specific safety statistics or accommodation support. The international application route provides faculty-defined processes and a formal application calendar.
universities.studentSupport: University of Porto publishes a dedicated international-student application route with faculty-defined admission requirements, phased dates and results procedures. FMUP's international Medicine page provides its own application phases, interviews and registration dates, giving applicants a programme-specific administrative route.

faq.question: Is Medicine at FMUP an undergraduate-entry programme?
faq.answer: It is an Integrated Master in Medicine. The programme lasts 12 semesters and 360 ECTS credits, and the 2026/27 international-student call offers a direct international admissions route subject to its entry conditions.

faq.question: What language is FMUP Medicine taught in?
faq.answer: The official course record lists Portuguese as the programme language. The published international route does not describe an English-medium Medicine track.

faq.question: What is the 2026/27 tuition for international Medicine students?
faq.answer: FMUP publishes 16,500 EUR for full-time international students in the Integrated Master in Medicine for 2026/27. This is tuition; it is not a complete housing, living or immigration budget.

faq.question: How many international Medicine places are available?
faq.answer: FMUP lists 12 places for Medicine in the 2026/27 international-student call. Place availability and any unfilled-place phases follow the faculty's published process.

faq.question: What are the 2026/27 FMUP application dates?
faq.answer: FMUP lists applications from 13 April to 8 May 2026 in phase one and 29 to 31 July 2026 in phase two. Interviews are scheduled 15-20 May and 4 August respectively; registration dates are also published by phase.

faq.question: Is there an interview?
faq.answer: Yes. FMUP's international Medicine calendar includes interviews in both published 2026/27 phases. The faculty's own regulation determines the detailed selection and ranking criteria.

faq.question: How is the degree recognised?
faq.answer: The course page records DGES registration R/A-Ef 2793/2011/AL06 dated 21 May 2026 and an A3ES accreditation decision published 31 July 2022 with six-year validity. These are programme-status records, not an automatic practice right abroad.

faq.question: What practical training is documented?
faq.answer: FMUP describes early contact with health units and patients, a pre-clinical medical-sciences stage and a clinical cycle applying the scientific base acquired. It does not publish a guaranteed named placement for each incoming student in the reviewed materials.

faq.question: Are accommodation costs included in tuition?
faq.answer: No accommodation figure or included housing service was verified in the official Medicine and admissions sources used here. Students need a separate Porto housing and living-cost plan.
